metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of a hybrid cloud / on-premises architecture. External users reach the application via a cloud CDN and load balancer, which routes requests through an IPsec VPN tunnel to on-premises application servers. Internal users access on-premises resources directly. The cloud layer provides VPN termination, object storage for backups, and centralised monitoring

elements.name: External Users
elements.description: Remote users accessing the application from the public internet via browser

elements.name: Internal Users
elements.description: Office employees accessing on-premises resources directly or via VPN

elements.name: Cloud Environment
elements.description: Public cloud layer providing CDN/LB, VPN termination, object storage, and monitoring

elements.name: CDN / Load Balancer
elements.description: Cloud-managed CDN and application load balancer. Terminates public HTTPS traffic and routes it to the cloud VPN gateway

elements.name: VPN Gateway (Cloud)
elements.description: Cloud-side IPsec VPN gateway. Establishes an encrypted tunnel to the on-premises VPN gateway

elements.name: Cloud Storage
elements.description: Object storage bucket. Receives backup syncs from the on-premises file server and application server

elements.name: Cloud Monitoring
elements.description: Centralised monitoring and alerting. Collects metrics and logs pushed by the on-premises application server

elements.name: VPN Gateway (On-Prem)
elements.description: On-premises IPsec VPN gateway. Terminates the cloud-side tunnel and forwards traffic to the internal firewall

elements.name: Firewall
elements.description: On-premises firewall. Filters traffic between the VPN gateway and internal servers

elements.name: App Server
elements.description: Core application server. Handles business logic, authenticates against Active Directory, and reads/writes the database and file server

elements.name: Database
elements.description: On-premises PostgreSQL database. Stores all application data

elements.name: File Server
elements.description: Shared NFS file server. Stores documents and media; syncs to cloud object storage for backup

elements.name: Active Directory
elements.description: On-premises Active Directory. Provides authentication and IAM for internal users and the application server
